text.en:
Republic Act No. 4073, otherwise known as "An Act Further Liberalizing the Treatment of
Leprosy by Amending and Repealing Certain Sections of the Revised Administrative Code" is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"Sections one thousand sixty to one thousand seventy-one, inclusive, of the same Code, as amended, are
hereby repealed, except section one thousand sixty-six; provided however, that the administrative control over
the Culion reservation, including the lands, waters, forest and forest products within the reservation, shall be
exercised by the Secretary of Health through the Chief of the Culion Sanitarium."
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
